long_biography.plain_text:
Prette entered the jewellery trade alongside his mother, Ariane, when they established a Monaco manufacturing business in 1982. The operation produced gold and gemstone pieces for established houses before moving production to China a decade later. That shift placed Prette close to Asian suppliers and consumers while building three decades of industrial expertise.

In 2012, he and creative director Kika Prette launched APM Monaco as a consumer brand built around frequently refreshed, attainable silver jewellery. Prette led the move from contract manufacturing into design, owned workshops and an international boutique network, and admitted a minority investment consortium while retaining influence. He remains chief executive. A long competitive career in Ferrari and endurance racing, including Le Mans with his son, forms a separate public identity.
